theme: A clear day — travel calls waiting to be closed.
greeting: The calendar is nearly empty today, Dan — just dinner out tonight. The open hours are the room to settle the travel decisions that have been sliding.

needsAttention.title: Lock the December break shortlist
needsAttention.detail: Your own call to pick three destinations was due yesterday, and booking closes Oct 15 — holiday inventory for six over three weeks is the thinnest of the year. Passports only land in November, so the clean path is domestic, or international on refundable bookings only.

needsAttention.title: Hold a Christmas SUV in Portland
needsAttention.detail: A p1 that's slid about two and a half weeks past due. The Pathfinder heads south this month, leaving no six-seater in Maine for Christmas; a refundable full-size SUV out of PWM sells out early over the holidays, so book now and fix the dates later.

needsAttention.title: Plan the Pathfinder drive south
needsAttention.detail: The Oct 5-18 off-week is the window to drive Portland to St Pete. Still open before Sunday: the hotel night for the two-day route, and where the car parks (TPA or SRQ long-term) the weeks you're not in Florida.
